status: Local changes; release metadata and published artifacts unchanged.
findings: Creature spells previously used whole-figure centres except for the toad. Wings, tails and pose changes also shifted those centres.
Physical projectiles previously started at a fixed 1.3 metres above the unit.
Will-o-the-wisp retains five animated translucent native motes; soft-alpha rendering was present, but the motes had no self-lit cores or halos for contrast against grass.

anchors: woodsfolk blowpipe for spells and darts
origin_checks: saved/replayed fireball origin and flight duration

localization: No player-visible text or options added. Original EN/RU/DE asset runs pass; translation checker reports 2687 entries, 141 dynamic wiki keys, 161 dynamic arena keys and zero errors.

captures.method: Wisp comparisons use the same frozen native pose and camera with only the new coronas disabled/enabled. Dragon capture shows the first rendered projectile tick from the authored casting release pose.

reproduction: Use isolated XDG_DATA_HOME/XDG_CONFIG_HOME/XDG_CACHE_HOME directories; start Godot with --path game --render-thread safe --audio-driver Dummy -- --ei-path=<original localized app directory> --tool=<absolute tools/tests/...gd path>.

Use --headless for origin and numerical regressions. For wisp_visibility.gd use --rendering-method forward_plus, gl_compatibility or mobile and pass --out=<capture directory>. Run python3 tools/check_translations.py.
limits: Renderer tests ran on Linux; Windows, browser and physical Android device builds were not exported or tested.
Forward+ and Mobile refer to Godot rendering methods, not separate device platforms.

diagnostics.note: An additional Forward+ source-marker capture encountered a Vulkan device-loss/driver crash in libnvidia-glcore.so.580.178.04. The identical capture script and source passed on rerun. The original full roster audit, dragon-fire capture, and all three final wisp renderer checks also completed successfully.
